research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sixfold AI is researching systems for identifying inconsistencies in data for underwriting by accessing medical records, extracting structured data, and comparing it to reference medical data to improve insurance decisions. It is also developing techniques for extracting rules and determining risk parameters from an underwriting manual, and for analyzing submissions for risk assessment based on a rule set, collectively advancing automated underwriting, rule extraction, and applicant risk evaluation.

overview_description.description: Sixfold AI provides an artificial intelligence platform that automates and augments insurance underwriting tasks, using AI to process submissions, extract risk data, and generate insights tailored to each insurer’s guidelines. The company’s technology assesses and triages cases, aligns risk evaluation with predefined appetites, and supports actions such as research, referrals, and documentation within underwriting workflows. Its solution integrates into existing systems to help underwriters focus on strategic judgment and relationship decisions rather than repetitive data work. Sixfold also emphasizes transparency by providing traceability of its risk insights and decisions. The platform supports multiple lines of insurance and adapts to specific underwriting criteria to deliver structured risk summaries and recommendations.

product.name: Sixfold Underwriting AI Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that ingests underwriting guidelines and risk data to provide tailored risk insights and submission triage for insurance underwriters.

product.name: Sixfold Cyber Insurance AI Solution
product.description: A specialized AI tool that extracts and summarizes cyber risk indicators to assist cyber insurance underwriters in evaluating submissions efficiently.

product.name: Sixfold Life & Disability Underwriting AI
product.description: An AI-driven system that extracts, analyzes, and summarizes medical and disability-related data to support life and disability insurance underwriting.
